extraction_notes: Target is the IRLR024N D-Pak (TO-252AA) surface-mount device. The alternate IRLU024N I-Pak package was excluded; shared IRLR/U024NPbF electrical-characteristic and typical-curve pages were used for the target.

Transfer, output, and capacitance curves are usable digitized typical traces from p. 3 Fig. 1 and Fig. 3 and p. 4 Fig. 5. Points are direct readings from visible graph traces and grid positions; no interpolation was used.
The transfer curve has no typical threshold table value; only the digitized typical curve is available in addition to the 1.0 V minimum and 2.0 V maximum threshold values.

The datasheet also publishes Qg = 15 nC typ, Qgs = 3.7 nC typ, Qgd = 8.5 nC typ, trr = 60 ns typ and 90 ns max, Qrr = 130 nC typ and 200 nC max, IDSS = 25 uA max at VDS = 55 V and 250 uA max at VDS = 44 V, TJ = 150 degC, and thermal resistances RthetaJC = 3.3 degC/W max, RthetaJA = 50 degC/W max on a 1 inch square PCB and 110 degC/W max junction-to-ambient; these have no fields in the strict schema.
The curve figures are typical data. The electrical-characteristics table values retain their published minimum, maximum, or typical source kinds and SI units.
